title: Generation Z preferences for cultural heritage landscapes using questionnaire and ERP methods
core_idea: Combine questionnaire surveys with ERP neuroscience techniques under a dual-process framework to construct an explicit–implicit dual-pathway model and investigate how Generation Z forms preferences for different types of cultural heritage landscapes (case study in Jingdezhen).
tldr: An interdisciplinary approach integrating questionnaires and ERP methods, grounded in dual-process theory, to identify and quantify the mechanisms by which Generation Z forms preferences for cultural heritage landscapes, with implications for heritage tourism planning and audience targeting.
